006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IHexBinaryItem;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.qname.EQNameFactory;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
013
014import org.apache.commons.codec.BinaryDecoder;
015import org.apache.commons.codec.BinaryEncoder;
016import org.apache.commons.codec.binary.Hex;
017
018import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
019import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
020import java.util.List;
021
022import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
023
024/**
025 * Maintains a byte buffer backed representation of a byte stream parsed from a
026 * base64 encoded string.
027 * <p>
028 * Provides support for the Metaschema <a href=
029 * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#base64">base64</a>
030 * data type.
031 */
032public class HexBinaryAdapter
033    extends AbstractBinaryAdapter<IHexBinaryItem> {
034  @NonNull
035  private static final List<IEnhancedQName> NAMES = ObjectUtils.notNull(List.of(
036      EQNameFactory.instance().newQName(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH, "hex-binary")));
037
038  @NonNull
039  private static final Hex HEX = new Hex(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
040
041  HexBinaryAdapter() {
042    super(IHexBinaryItem.class, IHexBinaryItem::cast);
043  }
044
045  @Override
046  protected BinaryEncoder getEncoder() {
047    return HEX;
048  }
049
050  @Override
051  protected BinaryDecoder getDecoder() {
052    return HEX;
053  }
054
055  @Override
056  public List<IEnhancedQName> getNames() {
057    return NAMES;
058  }
059
060  @Override
061  public IHexBinaryItem newItem(Object value) {
062    ByteBuffer item = toValue(value);
063    return IHexBinaryItem.valueOf(item);
064  }
065}
